chapter: Valor's Afterglow: The Faint Light Remembered
act_title: Valor's Afterglow: The Faint Light Remembered

quests.title: Valor's Afterglow: The Faint Light Remembered

dialogue.t: Yikes! Y—You scared me!
S—Sorry. Anyway, um, if you're looking for Zhiqiong... she left.

dialogue.sit: How was she doing when she left?

dialogue.t: I don't know... I was distracted for just a few moments, and that was it — she was gone.
I had a talk with her... but she insisted on leaving. I doubt I could have cajoled or browbeat her, or even beat her into staying.
*sigh* I just hope she knows what she's doing.
I really do hope so...
Ugh, right, I have to tell Muning, and get him to organize a search party for that kid!
Ugh, that Zhiqiong, she's gone again! Let's get back to the surface and look for Muning, quickly!
Hmm? Zhiqiong's not with you? Word's come down from the Ministry.

On account of the invaluable help that her maps have brought to the Huishan Hall, the Ministry of Civil Affairs has decided to make an exception for her and... Let me see, invite her to be formally accepted as a consultant and guide.
Congratulations to her are in order — it seems that all that running around wasn't for naught.
Left? What do you mean? Do you mean she left first? But the Millelith didn't tell me of anyone leaving The Chasm...
Eh? Uh...
Wait! Wait!
Hang on a moment, you mean she left the exploration team?
As in, Zhiqiong left the team?
Yes! Which part of that didn't you get?
...I get it. I will put a search and rescue party together immediately. If she is still in The Chasm, we should be able to find her.
She might just be doing something harebrained again, or perhaps she left for another reason... But regardless, we must find her.
In her current condition, working away from the team is simply far too reckless...
No, I don't reckon so... I suppose it's about time I stepped in as well.

dialogue.sit: I'll be there if you need me.

dialogue.t: Paimon too! We can't just leave our junior adventurer behind!
We'll look out while on the road as well. Who knows, maybe we'll bump into her somehow!

quests.description: Zhiqiong seems to have left the exploration team to explore on her own. Still, it’s too dangerous to go alone into The Chasm, so she must be found…
